en.text: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,

zhSimplified.text: 那时，又有许多人聚集，并没有什么吃的。耶稣叫门徒来，说：

zhTraditional.text: 那時，又有許多人聚集，並沒有甚麼吃的。耶穌叫門徒來，說：

en.text: “Ihave compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.

zhSimplified.text: 「我怜悯这众人；因为他们同我在这里已经三天，也没有吃的了。

zhTraditional.text: 「我憐憫這眾人；因為他們同我在這裏已經三天，也沒有吃的了。

en.text: IfI send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”

zhSimplified.text: 我若打发他们饿着回家，就必在路上困乏，因为其中有从远处来的。」

zhTraditional.text: 我若打發他們餓着回家，就必在路上困乏，因為其中有從遠處來的。」

en.text: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”

zhSimplified.text: 门徒回答说：「在这野地，从哪里能得饼，叫这些人吃饱呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 門徒回答說：「在這野地，從哪裏能得餅，叫這些人吃飽呢？」

en.text: He asked them, “Howmany loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣问他们说：「你们有多少饼？」他们说：「七个。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌問他們說：「你們有多少餅？」他們說：「七個。」

en.text: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

zhSimplified.text: 他吩咐众人坐在地上，就拿着这七个饼祝谢了，擘开，递给门徒，叫他们摆开，门徒就摆在众人面前。

zhTraditional.text: 他吩咐眾人坐在地上，就拿着這七個餅祝謝了，擘開，遞給門徒，叫他們擺開，門徒就擺在眾人面前。

en.text: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

zhSimplified.text: 又有几条小鱼；耶稣祝了福，就吩咐也摆在众人面前。

zhTraditional.text: 又有幾條小魚；耶穌祝了福，就吩咐也擺在眾人面前。

en.text: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

zhSimplified.text: 众人都吃，并且吃饱了，收拾剩下的零碎，有七筐子。

zhTraditional.text: 眾人都吃，並且吃飽了，收拾剩下的零碎，有七筐子。

en.text: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

zhSimplified.text: 人数约有四千。耶稣打发他们走了，

zhTraditional.text: 人數約有四千。耶穌打發他們走了，

en.text: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

zhSimplified.text: 随即同门徒上船，来到大玛努他境内。 （太16·1—4）

zhTraditional.text: 隨即同門徒上船，來到大瑪努他境內。 （太16‧1－4）

en.text: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.

zhSimplified.text: 法利赛人出来盘问耶稣，求他从天上显个神迹给他们看，想要试探他。

zhTraditional.text: 法利賽人出來盤問耶穌，求他從天上顯個神蹟給他們看，想要試探他。

en.text: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Whydoes this generation seeka sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

footnotes.text: 8:12 The word translated “generation” here (genea) could also be translated “people”, “race”, or “family”.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣心里深深地叹息，说：「这世代为什么求神迹呢？我实在告诉你们，没有神迹给这世代看。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌心裏深深地歎息，說：「這世代為甚麼求神蹟呢？我實在告訴你們，沒有神蹟給這世代看。」

en.text: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

zhSimplified.text: 他就离开他们，又上船往海那边去了。 （太16·5—12）

zhTraditional.text: 他就離開他們，又上船往海那邊去了。 （太16‧5－12）

en.text: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

zhSimplified.text: 门徒忘了带饼；在船上除了一个饼，没有别的食物。

zhTraditional.text: 門徒忘了帶餅；在船上除了一個餅，沒有別的食物。

en.text: He warned them, saying, “Takeheed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣嘱咐他们说：「你们要谨慎，防备法利赛人的酵和希律的酵。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌囑咐他們說：「你們要謹慎，防備法利賽人的酵和希律的酵。」

en.text: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们彼此议论说：「这是因为我们没有饼吧。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們彼此議論說：「這是因為我們沒有餅吧。」

en.text: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Whydo you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’ t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣看出来，就说：「你们为什么因为没有饼就议论呢？你们还不省悟，还不明白吗？你们的心还是愚顽吗？

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌看出來，就說：「你們為甚麼因為沒有餅就議論呢？你們還不省悟，還不明白嗎？你們的心還是愚頑嗎？

en.text: Havingeyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?

zhSimplified.text: 你们有眼睛，看不见吗？有耳朵，听不见吗？也不记得吗？

zhTraditional.text: 你們有眼睛，看不見嗎？有耳朵，聽不見嗎？也不記得嗎？

en.text: WhenI broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”

zhSimplified.text: 我擘开那五个饼分给五千人，你们收拾的零碎装满了多少篮子呢？」他们说：「十二个。」

zhTraditional.text: 我擘開那五個餅分給五千人，你們收拾的零碎裝滿了多少籃子呢？」他們說：「十二個。」

en.text: “Whenthe seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”

zhSimplified.text: 「又擘开那七个饼分给四千人，你们收拾的零碎装满了多少筐子呢？」他们说：「七个。」

zhTraditional.text: 「又擘開那七個餅分給四千人，你們收拾的零碎裝滿了多少筐子呢？」他們說：「七個。」

en.text: He asked them, “Don’t youunderstand yet?”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「你们还是不明白吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「你們還是不明白嗎？」

en.text: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.

zhSimplified.text: 他们来到伯赛大，有人带一个瞎子来，求耶稣摸他。

zhTraditional.text: 他們來到伯賽大，有人帶一個瞎子來，求耶穌摸他。

en.text: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣拉着瞎子的手，领他到村外，就吐唾沫在他眼睛上，按手在他身上，问他说：「你看见什么了？」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌拉着瞎子的手，領他到村外，就吐唾沫在他眼睛上，按手在他身上，問他說：「你看見甚麼了？」

en.text: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”

zhSimplified.text: 他就抬头一看，说：「我看见人了；他们好像树木，并且行走。」

zhTraditional.text: 他就抬頭一看，說：「我看見人了；他們好像樹木，並且行走。」

en.text: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

zhSimplified.text: 随后又按手在他眼睛上，他定睛一看，就复了原，样样都看得清楚了。

zhTraditional.text: 隨後又按手在他眼睛上，他定睛一看，就復了原，樣樣都看得清楚了。

en.text: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’tenter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣打发他回家，说：「连这村子你也不要进去。」 （太16·13—20；路9·18—21）

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌打發他回家，說：「連這村子你也不要進去。」 （太16‧13－20；路9‧18－21）

en.text: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Whodo men say that I am?”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣和门徒出去，往凯撒利亚·腓立比村庄去；在路上问门徒说：「人说我是谁？」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌和門徒出去，往凱撒利亞‧腓立比村莊去；在路上問門徒說：「人說我是誰？」

en.text: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们说：「有人说是施洗的约翰；有人说是以利亚；又有人说是先知里的一位。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們說：「有人說是施洗的約翰；有人說是以利亞；又有人說是先知裏的一位。」

en.text: He said to them, “Butwho do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”

zhSimplified.text: 又问他们说：「你们说我是谁？」彼得回答说：「你是基督。」

zhTraditional.text: 又問他們說：「你們說我是誰？」彼得回答說：「你是基督。」

en.text: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣就禁戒他们，不要告诉人。 （太16·21—28；路9·22—27）

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌就禁戒他們，不要告訴人。 （太16‧21－28；路9‧22－27）

en.text: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

zhSimplified.text: 从此，他教训他们说：「人子必须受许多的苦，被长老、祭司长，和文士弃绝，并且被杀，过三天复活。」

zhTraditional.text: 從此，他教訓他們說：「人子必須受許多的苦，被長老、祭司長，和文士棄絕，並且被殺，過三天復活。」

en.text: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣明明地说这话，彼得就拉着他，劝他。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌明明地說這話，彼得就拉着他，勸他。

en.text: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Getbehind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣转过来，看着门徒，就责备彼得说：「撒但，退我后边去吧！因为你不体贴 神的意思，只体贴人的意思。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌轉過來，看着門徒，就責備彼得說：「撒但，退我後邊去吧！因為你不體貼上帝的意思，只體貼人的意思。」

en.text: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoeverwants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

zhSimplified.text: 于是叫众人和门徒来，对他们说：「若有人要跟从我，就当舍己，背起他的十字架来跟从我。

zhTraditional.text: 於是叫眾人和門徒來，對他們說：「若有人要跟從我，就當捨己，背起他的十字架來跟從我。

en.text: Forwhoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，凡要救自己生命的，必丧掉生命；凡为我和福音丧掉生命的，必救了生命。

zhTraditional.text: 因為，凡要救自己生命的，必喪掉生命；凡為我和福音喪掉生命的，必救了生命。

en.text: Forwhat does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?

zhSimplified.text: 人就是赚得全世界，赔上自己的生命，有什么益处呢？

zhTraditional.text: 人就是賺得全世界，賠上自己的生命，有甚麼益處呢？

en.text: Forwhat will a man give in exchange for his life?

zhSimplified.text: 人还能拿什么换生命呢？

zhTraditional.text: 人還能拿甚麼換生命呢？

en.text: Forwhoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

zhSimplified.text: 凡在这淫乱罪恶的世代，把我和我的道当作可耻的，人子在他父的荣耀里，同圣天使降临的时候，也要把那人当作可耻的。」

zhTraditional.text: 凡在這淫亂罪惡的世代，把我和我的道當作可恥的，人子在他父的榮耀裏，同聖天使降臨的時候，也要把那人當作可恥的。」
